FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 96
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Economic Development
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/21/2026
Senate Bill 96 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Governor's
office to certify immediate danger to the public health, safety, or welfare to establish an
emergency rule. This bill would otherwise not affect state or local funding.
